q1.prompt: You need the longest contiguous subarray with at most k distinct values. Which method?

choices.label: Sliding window — grow right, shrink left when the constraint breaks
Pick any subset of indices, contiguous or not

wrong_subset.prompt: A window only covers contiguous spans.
wrong_subset.explanation: Sliding window maintains a contiguous [left, right]. Non-contiguous subsets need a different tool.

q2.prompt: Which input shape breaks the sliding-window invariant?

choices.label: When the needed subset is not contiguous, or each shrink rescans the whole window
Any subarray or subsequence problem is a window

wrong_refuse.explanation: Avoid a window when the needed subset is not contiguous. Avoid claiming linear time if each shrink rescans the whole window from scratch. Avoid a fixed-size template for a variable-constraint problem.

success.prompt: You matched windows to contiguous constraints and avoided non-contiguous asks.
